translations.web: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.
translations.bsb: A man is praised according to his wisdom, but a twisted mind is despised.
translations.kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
translations.asv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom; But he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
